summary: Mixed group-claim formats in SAML assertion cause incomplete RBAC resolution for support tooling
description:
Issue summary:
Users logging into support-portal and internal runners intermittently receive only a subset of their expected roles. Impacted users report missing runbook elevation, disabled 'execute' buttons in the support UI, and 403s from terraform-runner even though Okta membership appears correct in the IdP.

Impact:
- Several oncall engineers could not escalate runbooks during a routine test window.
- Automated CI jobs that rely on JIT RBAC for terraform-runner failed for a small cohort of users.

Environment:
- Production (us-east) behind auth-proxy v2.13.1 and identity-service v1.8.0.
- Okta tenant: redwood-inc.okta.com (production).

Steps to reproduce:
1) Use an Okta user that is a member of groups with mixed claim styles (legacy comma-separated claim 'oktaGroups' and newer JSON array claim 'groups').
2) Authenticate via SAML SSO to support-portal web UI (or hit OIDC exchange for runner CLI).
3) Inspect resolved RBAC claims via /debug/session endpoint or observe missing roles in UI.

Expected behavior:
- Identity service should combine and normalize both group claims so role-mapping rules match and users receive full, expected RBAC grants.

Actual behavior:
- Identity service only applies the first seen group claim token when both 'oktaGroups' (CSV) and 'groups' (JSON array) are present. Because our role-mapping regex expects prefixes that appear only in one of the claim formats, users are granted partial sets of roles.

Logs / evidence:
- auth-proxy logs show header X-IdP-Groups: "team-support, rw:platform-admin" but identity-service normalized to ["team-support"].
- Identity service audit trace: "parsed_groups_count=1 parsed_oktaGroups=true parsed_groups_json=true priority=oktaGroups"
- Sample SAML assertion (redacted) attached in ticket.

Attachments:
- saml_assertion_sample.redacted.txt (assertion contains both claims)
comments: 2026-03-11 | Asha Patel (reporter): Noticed this after oncall dry-run. Added sample SAML assertion and auth-proxy trace. Impact looks limited to users who still have legacy group claim in Okta. Marking P1 due to oncall impact.

2026-03-11 | Liam O'Rourke (assignee): Taking ownership. Reproduced locally with a mock assertion. Initial hypothesis: claim-priority logic in identity-service favors oktaGroups CSV over JSON groups array, then stops parsing further. Will instrument parsing path and capture audit logs.

2026-03-12 | Elena Moreno (SRE): Observed elevated 403s from terraform-runner for three distinct user IDs between 02:00-03:30 UTC. Linked grafana panel: https://grafana.internal.redwood/r/ABC123/auth-errors (internal link). No increased CPU or memory on identity-service pods during incidents.

2026-03-12 | Rajiv Singh (Identity Eng): Confirmed bug in claim parser: newline-delimited CSV in oktaGroups triggers early return when oktaGroups is present. Patch in review to merge both claim sources and dedupe groups. PR: https://github.com/redwood/identity-service/pull/5124
2026-03-13 | Liam O'Rourke: Deployed a debug build to canary namespace and validated combined group set for test user. Preparing rollout plan and mitigation notes.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: claim priority logic short-circuits parsing when oktaGroups exists, causing collector to ignore groups[] array that contains rw: prefixed roles.
Confirmed with unit test: identity-service v1.8.0 behavior returns only first parsed claim set (oktaGroups) and does not merge; regression introduced in v1.7.9 when optimizing for header size.
Auth-proxy sends both headers extracted from SAML: X-Okta-Groups (CSV) and X-Groups-Json (json array). Identity-service currently reads X-Okta-Groups only if present.
Related incident: none opened; impact contained to subset of users, no page.
workaround: Short term: Identity Eng can toggle a feature-flag on the identity-service to 'merge-okta-groups' remotely. Affected users should re-authenticate after the toggle. Okta admins can also remove legacy oktaGroups CSV claim on impacted profiles as an immediate patch.
planned_fix: Merge PR #5124 to main which changes parser to: (1) read both CSV and JSON group claims, (2) normalize prefixes, (3) dedupe entries. Canaries scheduled 2026-03-14 02:00 UTC in us-east, followed by gradual rollout. Post-deploy verification will use /debug/session checks and automated synthetic logins.
next_steps: Finish code review and security sign-off for PR #5124 (Identity Eng)
Notify Okta admins to identify affected users and optionally remove legacy claim (Customer Identity team)
After canary verification, roll out to prod and update runbook with claim-normalization notes (Documentation)
Close ticket after verification and retrospective note added to Confluence
